description: For a date, gives the CIS tax month it falls in (the 6th to the 5th), the tax year, the date the monthly return (CIS300) is due (the 19th, also the date for paying HMRC by any means other than electronically), and the date for paying HMRC electronically (the 22nd, moved back to the banking day before when the 22nd is a weekend or an England and Wales bank holiday). Bank holidays are known to bank_holidays_known_until; after that only weekends move the date.

date.description: Any date, such as a payment date or today, YYYY-MM-DD

name: cis_tax_month
title: CIS tax month and deadlines
